## Risk checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behaviour and important failure paths.
- [ ] Security, privacy, permissions, and sensitive output were considered.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, and rollback were considered.
- [ ] Terminal accessibility and clear, non-overclaiming copy were considered.
- [ ] Documentation, fixtures, Helm values, and public contracts are updated where needed.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor, dependency update, generated artefact, credential, or production identifier is included.
